content: माला [मल् संज्ञायां कर्तरि घञ्] .²1 A garland, wreath, chaplet; अनधिगतपरिमलापि हि हरति दृशं मालतीमाला <ls>Vās.</ls> .²2 A row, line, series, succession; गण्डोड्डीनालिमाला <ls>Māl. 1. 1</ls>; आबद्धमालाः <ls>Me. 9</ls>. .²3 A group, cluster, collection. .²4 A string, necklace; as in रत्नमाला. .²5 A rosary, chain; as in अक्षमाला. .²6 A streak; as in तडिन्माला, विद्युन्माला. .²7 A series of epithets. .²8 (In dramas) The offering of several things to obtain a wish. .²9 A vocabulary, dictionary.
